scripts.build: npm run build -w web-admin && npm run build -w web-client && npm run build -w web-shipper
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w web-admin && npm run lint -w web-client && npm run lint -w web-shipper
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w web-admin && npm run typecheck -w web-client && npm run typecheck -w web-shipper
scripts.test:release:static: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/*.test.mjs && npm run test:client && npm test -w web-shipper && node scripts/ci/validate-ci.mjs
scripts.check:ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:release:static && npm run build
scripts.fix:local: prettier --write "**/*.{ts,tsx,md,json}" && npm run lint-fix -w web-admin && npm run lint-fix -w web-client && npm run lint-fix -w web-shipper
